account.deleteBody: Your Cuentiva account is deleted: your name, email and photo are removed, all your sessions are closed and you no longer belong to the businesses where you worked. This cannot be undone.
account.teamNote: Sales and records you entered in other people's businesses stay in their books (they belong to that business), without your personal data.
account.ownsBody: You own: {{names}}. Before deleting your account, those businesses must be deleted (or handed over to someone else).

deletePage.title: Delete your Cuentiva account and data
deletePage.intro: Cuentiva is a register for small shops. This is how you can delete your account and your business data at any time, from the app or from the web panel.
deletePage.ownerTitle: If you are the owner (you sign in with Google)
ownerSteps: If you have a business: in the app go to More › Business settings › "Delete business" (or in the web panel: Settings › Danger zone). Confirm by typing the business name. The business stops working immediately on every phone and all its data (sales, products, customers, credit, expenses, team) is permanently erased after 30 days.
Then, in the app go to More › My account › "Delete my account" (or in the web panel: menu › "Delete my account"). Your name, email and photo are deleted and all your sessions are closed.
deletePage.teamTitle: If you are part of a team (you sign in with the business code, username and PIN)
deletePage.teamBody: You do not have an account of your own: the business owner created your user. To delete it, ask the owner or an admin to deactivate you in More › Team. Your name can no longer sign in; the sales you recorded stay in the business's books.
deletePage.dataTitle: What is deleted and what is kept
deletePage.dataBody: Deleting a business erases everything that belongs to it after 30 days. Deleting your account removes your personal data immediately. Only this is kept, for security and legal obligations:
keptItems: an internal record that the business or account was deleted (date and technical reason), with no sales or customer data;
encrypted backups, which rotate on their own and disappear within 30 days at most.
deletePage.helpBody: Write to us from the app (More › Help and contact) or from the web panel (Help). If you can no longer sign in, write to the support email shown on the app's Google Play listing.
